claim: An explicit rational 4x8 PPT state rho of Schmidt number at least 3 and a rational 2-block-positive witness W with Tr(W rho)<0 are given below. This is a genuinely new source pair for the present rank<=4 negative-filter question; no negative rank<=4 filter is asserted. The original 4x4 target remains OPEN.
source: For r=0,...,10 set h_r=sum_(0<=i<4,0<=j<8,i+j=r)|i,j> and sigma=sum_r [h_r]/binomial(10,r). Let V be the 4x8 integer matrix [[2,0,-2,-2,-1,-2,-1,-1],[2,-1,1,-2,2,1,2,0],[-2,1,0,-1,-1,1,1,2],[0,2,-3,-2,-2,2,-2,1]], vectorized as |V>. Define rho=2041200*sigma+[V]. The h_r have pairwise disjoint support, hence sigma>=0 has rank 11 and range L of all 4x8 Hankel matrices H_ij=h_(i+j). A separate exact Fraction Schur calculation verifies sigma^Gamma-I/12600 is PSD of rank 32. Also ||V||_F^2=81 and partial transpose preserves Frobenius norm, so ||[V]^Gamma||_op<=81. Therefore rho^Gamma>=2041200/12600 I-81 I=81 I, and rho is PPT with strictly positive partial transpose. V is not in L, so rho has rank 12.
explicit_witness: Let P_L=sum_r [h_r]/||h_r||^2, let v_perp=(I-P_L)|V> and beta=||v_perp||^2=337/6, and set P=I-P_L-[v_perp]/beta, the orthogonal projector onto K^perp where K=L+span(V). Define a=(|1,0>-|0,1>)/2, M=16*25^4=6250000, delta=1/(2(M+1)^2)=1/78125025000002, and W=P-delta[a]. All entries are rational. Since a is perpendicular to L, <a|V>=1, and P annihilates K, Tr(W rho)=-delta. The following all-variable argument proves W is 2-block positive.
pluecker_transversality: For a 4x8 matrix Z define the 5x6 compatibility matrix C(Z)_(t,ij)=Z_(j,t+i)-Z_(i,t+j), with 0<=t<=4 and pairs ij ordered 01,02,03,12,13,23. Every Hankel H has C(H)=0. For the displayed V, C(V)=[[2,0,2,0,4,-2],[1,3,3,2,-5,-1],[3,1,-1,-3,-3,-3],[-1,1,-1,-2,-4,1],[4,0,-1,-1,2,-4]]. Its first five columns D have determinant 174, and its kernel is span p_*=(1,0,0,0,0,1), whose Pluecker quadratic p_01 p_23-p_02 p_13+p_03 p_12 equals 1. Hence no nonzero decomposable two-vector lies in the kernel.
quantitative_rank_two_proof: Take any rank<=2 matrix X and orthonormal row covectors alpha,beta annihilating X. Their Pluecker vector p_ij=alpha_i beta_j-alpha_j beta_i has sum |p_ij|^2=1 and obeys the Pluecker quadratic; a direct shifted linear combination of alpha X=beta X=0 yields C(X)p=0. Write X=Y+E with Y=P_K X=H+zV, H in L, and e=||E||_F. Thus z C(V)p=-C(E)p. Put q=p_01-p_23 and r=(q,p_02,p_03,p_12,p_13). Since |p_01+p_23|=|alpha^T(J_2 direct_sum J_2)beta|<=1, the unit-norm identity gives ||r||^2>=1/2. Because C(V)p=D r, det D=174 and every D entry has modulus <=5, ||D||_F<=25 and the singular-value product bound gives ||D r|| >=174||r||/25^4 >=1/(2*25^4). Each of the 30 entries of C(E) is a difference of two E entries, so ||C(E)||_op<=||C(E)||_F<=sqrt(60)e<8e. Hence e>=|z|/M. As <a|H>=0 and <a|V>=1, <a|Y>=z; also ||a||<=1, so |<a|X>| <= |z|+e <=(M+1)e. Consequently <X|W|X> >= e^2-delta(M+1)^2 e^2 = e^2/2 >=0, exactly for every complex rank<=2 X. Since W detects PPT rho, the associated M4-to-M8 map is indecomposable.
